messages.content: Morning. Did you get a chance to look at the thoracic study I sent over?
I did. Positioning is off - the forelimbs are not drawn far enough forward, so the cranial lobes are obscured.
That would explain the opacity everyone was arguing about.
Almost certainly. Worth repeating before anyone commits to a diagnosis.
Will redo it this afternoon. Thanks for looking so quickly.
Are you teaching on the final-year rotation this term?
Two afternoons a fortnight. Why, are you looking to swap one?
Hoping to sit in, actually. I want to see how you teach palpation before I try it with my own group.
Come whenever. Fair warning, the first half hour is mostly me telling them to slow down.
Quick one - do you have a written anaesthetic checklist I could borrow? Ours is still verbal and it is starting to show.
Happy to adapt whatever you have rather than start from nothing.
Yes, I will send it across tonight. It is one page, which is the only reason people actually use it.
One page is exactly what I need. Thank you.
Did you see the elimination-diet case on the feed? The eight-week compliance question comes up constantly here.
I did. Writing the plan down for the owner seems to be the thing that makes the difference.
We started giving out a printed sheet last year and the drop-off at week three nearly halved.
I can send you the template if it is useful.
Thanks for covering the Saturday list last month - it made a real difference.
Any time. Let me know when the rota comes out for next quarter.
Is the imaging room free on Thursday afternoon? I have a teaching session I would like to run in there.
Should be after three. I will put your name against it.
